payload.name: acceptance_criteria
payload.value:
A PreToolUse Bash hook refuses a command that discards uncommitted work (git checkout -- path, git checkout HEAD -- path, git restore without --staged, git stash in any form except list and show, git reset --hard and git clean except its dry run, also inside a chained command or after git -C), unless the same command segment names an approval as BASICLY_APPROVAL=record@UTC-stamp under 60 minutes old; an accepted use is logged to .basicly/usage/approvals.jsonl. git restore --staged, git stash list and git stash show pass.
The hook is registered and projected.
